items.q: What should you remember about **Self-consciousness about your voice is nearly universal**?
items.a: **especially painful for podcasters** who must review their own audio.

items.q: What should you remember about **Bone conduction vs air conduction** explains the "that's not me" recording shock?
What should you remember about **Mirror/photo parallel**?
items.a: **you see yourself in the mirror** daily (flipped); photos show the "real" view others see. Same pattern for voice.

items.q: What should you remember about **Recalibration takes time**?
items.a: **repeated exposure closes the** gap between what you hear internally and what recordings reveal.

items.q: What should you remember about **Avoidance perpetuates discomfort**?
items.a: **skipping playback keeps perception and reception permanently misaligned.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Reality check**?
items.a: when you hear yourself on a recording, **that is how you sound** to the world; same as video showing how you look.

items.q: What should you remember about **Mindset before technique**?
items.a: **embrace your instrument before** applying vocal habits from 9 habits for clearer speaking.
